ⓘ HOW IT WORKS
Crew Dividend = your savings × your tier %
• Your savings = money saved on your flying days ÷ the pilots on board (👥 Crew size per day). Save each day in Money Saving.
• Your tier = your monthly CBE Index. Same % for Captain and FO. A loss month = €0.
Balance & Time Bank
• Each ended month goes into your balance. Take money (any amount) or whole free days: €600 PIC / €300 SIC.
• Balance and days are kept 12 months, then paid out. Bank max 17 days.
• Days at the start or end of a rotation, request by the 15th of the month before.
• Elite: Every 2 Elite months in a row = 1 extra free day (losing Elite starts the count again). Figures are estimates — payroll confirms.
